name: THE PATRONS
note:
One card player, above the tabletop only, as his own sprite with his own beat.
THE SHEET HONOURED ALL FOUR RULES, which is why this finally works. Below row 82 nothing moves at all -- mean change 0.15 across every pose -- so the table, the chairs and every man’s legs live in the static plate. Above it each man keeps to his own vertical band with clear space between him and his neighbour, so the four bands cut apart cleanly: each changes in exactly ONE pose and is byte-identical, 0.0, in the other three. The blue-coated man lays a card down.

sprite.note: A beat, not a loop: at rest, and every few seconds the movement plays once. Intervals of 13, 19, 9 and 15 seconds share no common factor below 5 minutes, so the four never fall into a pattern.
